message: As a parent, I know it can be a bit of a juggling act when it comes to preparing the kids for emergencies. Fire safety is one of those topics that feels really important, but it’s easy to brush off when everyone’s busy. I found a resource that lays out some practical steps on how to handle fire emergencies in a way that’s friendly and straightforward. It’s a great way to turn a serious topic into a family conversation—what are some ways you talk about safety with your kids?
